content.text:
The result of (37 × 12 + 159) ÷ 9 is **67**.

My first attempt entered the expression without parentheses, so the Calculator applied the precedence rules and showed 461.67. I cleared it and entered the steps one at a time (37 × 12 = 444, + 159 = 603, ÷ 9 = 67). The display now shows 603 ÷ 9 = 67.
